 Large 75″ Sony Bravia 5 mini-LED TV hits its best price in months on Amazon with limited-time deal

 More 75-inch TV deals 
 This excellent Sony Bravia 5 mini-LED TV has dropped to its best price in months on Amazon, with a hefty 20% off, coming in at $1,598.00 with a limited-time deal. Its record-low price was hit back in April this year, but since July, it’s been pretty quiet on the discount front. If you’ve had your eye on this, it could be a good chance to grab it for less.
 Considering this is a 75-inch mini-LED TV , that’s actually a pretty compelling price, especially for those who want big-screen viewing with exceptional picture quality but don’t want to pay absolute top-end prices. This TV pretty much ticks all the boxes for a competitive price. You’re getting excellent contrast and brightness, true-to-life color, gaming features designed with PS5 in mind, and a powerful Sony processor at its core.

 What we like about this Sony 75-inch Bravia 5 mini-LED TV
 Brilliant mini-LED display
 With more and smaller LEDs than your typical LED/LCD TV, this TV has way more control over brightness and contrast, which results in much more lifelike, cinematic, and atmospheric visuals. This TV’s backlight is controlled by its XR Backlight Master Drive, which can help reduce blooming.

 XR Triluminos Pro for outstanding color 
 This technology is designed to reproduce a wider range of colors, but also be able to produce much more subtle shades and hues. That’s great for skin tones, for example, which can sometimes look either washed out or oversaturated. It’s a big win if you’re watching anything that really benefits from looking more true-to-life. 
 Excellent gaming features
 Having a 120Hz refresh rate is one thing, as it unlocks up to 120fps at 4K when gaming, but it’s not the whole picture. This TV has VRR and ALLM, which both help improve your overall gaming experience by reducing screen tearing and stuttering and lowering latency, respectively. 
 Primed for immersive, cinematic viewing
 It supports Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, which primes this TV very nicely for cinematic movie nights, where you can enjoy films with dynamic picture settings and immersive audio. 
 Via camelcamelcamel 
 Who’s this TV for?
 This is a very good option to consider if you’re after something large, with good picture quality and gaming features, that’s going to be more affordable than most smaller OLED alternatives. Not all mini-LEDs are made the same, of course, and one of the slight drawbacks is that they can sometimes have a bit of blooming in high-contrast scenes. Still, picture quality will be far superior to a standard QLED TV of the same size.
